name: Zamek's Distraction
summary: Zamek can create the diversion that Keeping Pace calls for. It comes while you are in the middle of that step, and Keeping Pace cannot be finished without it.

sections.title: A Timely Diversion
sections.body: While you are working through Keeping Pace, Zamek can create a diversion. When it happens, Rizzle leaves his hut, and the Indurium plans are left behind.

aliases: where do i get zameks distraction

faq.q: How does this relate to Keeping Pace?
aliases: is this needed for keeping pace
faq.answer: It comes while you are in the middle of Keeping Pace, and that step cannot be finished without it.
Rizzle leaves his hut, and his plans are left behind.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde adventurers work with Zamek?
faq.answer: Yes. It is neutral, open to either faction.
